canary-distributed-resources.body:
# Canary distributed resource adapter

## First actions

```console
canary query -c ext.dist.overview
canary query -c ext.dist.adapter
canary query -c ext.dist.allocation
```

## What this extension does

The distributed resource adapter checks out resources from a remote server and returns a Canary allocation object with metadata and node-tagged resources.

## Important limitations

- Multi-node requests are not supported by the distributed adapter.
- Local capacity checks are approximate.
- Checkout and checkin are server-authoritative.

## Debugging tips

- Confirm the server URL is correct.
- Query the server status through the adapter path if instrumented.
- Check that machine tags and groups match the current run configuration.
- Ensure every checked-out allocation is checked back in with its transaction ID.
